GameOfLife compile: 'drawOn: canvas
	liveCells do: [ :p |
		canvas add: (RSBox new
			size: 18;
			color: Color black;
			position: (p x * 22) @ (p y negated * 22)) ]'. GameOfLife compile: 'openView
	| canvas |
	canvas := RSCanvas new.
	canvas color: Color white.
	self drawOn: canvas.
	^ canvas open'. GameOfLife compile: 'paintBoxes: boxes
	boxes keysAndValuesDo: [ :point :box |
		box color: ((liveCells includes: point)
			ifTrue: [ Color black ]
			ifFalse: [ Color white ]) ]'. GameOfLife compile: 'openEvolutionView
	| canvas boxes origin extent |
	extent := 30.
	origin := extent // 2.
	canvas := RSCanvas new.
	canvas color: Color veryLightGray.
	boxes := Dictionary new.
	origin negated to: (extent - origin) do: [ :gx |
		origin negated to: (extent - origin) do: [ :gy |
			| box |
			box := RSBox new
				size: 18;
				color: Color white.
			box position: (gx * 22) @ (gy negated * 22).
			canvas add: box.
			boxes at: gx @ gy put: box ] ].
	self paintBoxes: boxes.
	canvas open.
	[ | life |
		life := self.
		300 timesRepeat: [
			(Delay forMilliseconds: 250) wait.
			life := life nextGeneration.
			life paintBoxes: boxes.
			canvas signalUpdate ] ] fork'. #viewsCompiled
